claims.subject: Westfleisch Group
claims.claim: Westfleisch states that around 7,600 people work across the group.
claims.boundary: Employee count is a scale signal; it does not measure animal throughput, welfare impact or responsibility.
claims.falsification_condition: A newer company disclosure or authoritative filing materially changes the employee count.

claims.subject: Westfleisch
claims.claim: Westfleisch states that it operates across 10 locations in northwest Germany.
claims.boundary: A group location count does not mean every site performs slaughter or animal handling.
claims.falsification_condition: A current company or official site register materially changes the number or scope of locations.

claims.subject: Westfleisch
claims.claim: Westfleisch reports total annual sales volume of around 900,000 tonnes.
claims.boundary: Sales volume is not the same as live-animal throughput and is not a suffering metric.
claims.falsification_condition: A newer company disclosure or audited report materially changes the reported sales volume.

claims.subject: Westfleisch
claims.object: about two thirds domestic and one third export
claims.claim: Westfleisch states that roughly two thirds of its total sales go to the German market and one third to export markets.
claims.boundary: This does not identify named customers, retailers, products or destination countries for specific shipments.
claims.falsification_condition: A newer company disclosure materially changes the domestic/export split.

claims.subject: Westfleisch
claims.claim: Westfleisch states that it exports products to 40 countries worldwide.
claims.boundary: Export reach does not establish a specific buyer, contract, shipment or product flow.
claims.falsification_condition: A newer company disclosure materially changes the number of export countries.

claims.subject: Westfleisch Finanz AG
claims.object: food-production buildings and technical installations for Westfleisch entities
claims.claim: Westfleisch states that Westfleisch Finanz AG constructs and finances buildings and technical installations for food production and leases them exclusively to Westfleisch SCE and affiliated subsidiaries.
claims.boundary: This describes the group's infrastructure-financing role; it does not establish ownership of every operating asset or financing terms.
claims.falsification_condition: A current company or corporate filing materially changes the entity's role or leasing scope.

claims.subject: Westfleisch Erkenschwick GmbH
claims.object: Oer-Erkenschwick pig slaughter and cutting mono-operation
claims.claim: Westfleisch identifies Westfleisch Erkenschwick GmbH as the entity at its Oer-Erkenschwick meat centre and describes the site as a mono-operation for pig slaughter and cutting.
claims.boundary: This does not connect a named farm or shipment to the site.
claims.falsification_condition: A current company or official facility record shows a different operator or function.

claims.subject: Gustoland GmbH
claims.claim: Westfleisch states that its subsidiary Gustoland is located on the Oer-Erkenschwick site and specializes in sausage and convenience products.
claims.boundary: Co-location does not prove that every product uses meat slaughtered at the adjacent facility or trace a particular animal into a product.
claims.falsification_condition: A current company disclosure materially changes the location, ownership or production role.

claims.subject: Westfleisch SCE mbH
claims.claim: Westfleisch identifies Westfleisch SCE mbH as the legal entity at Fleischcenter Coesfeld.
claims.boundary: Facility operator identification does not prove a named farm-to-site shipment.
claims.falsification_condition: A current company or official facility record identifies a different legal operator.

claims.subject: Fleischcenter Hamm
claims.object: pig slaughter and cutting mono-operation in 2021
claims.claim: Westfleisch states that Fleischcenter Hamm was converted in 2021 into a mono-operation for pig slaughter and cutting.
claims.boundary: This describes site function; it does not identify the origin of individual animals or downstream products.
claims.falsification_condition: A current company or official facility record materially changes the site's function.

claims.subject: Westfleisch
claims.claim: Westfleisch states that it took over the cattle slaughter operation in Bakum in 2015.
claims.boundary: A historical acquisition does not by itself establish every current legal or property detail.
claims.falsification_condition: A current corporate or official record shows the operator or ownership status has changed.

claims.subject: Fleischcenter Lübbecke
claims.claim: Westfleisch states that Fleischcenter Lübbecke has operated as a cattle-only mono-operation since 2014.
claims.boundary: This does not identify the farms supplying a particular animal or downstream customer.
claims.falsification_condition: A current company or official facility record materially changes the site's function.

claims.subject: Wetralog GmbH
claims.claim: Westfleisch states that Wetralog is responsible for the group's overall logistics and also handles live-animal transport.
claims.boundary: This establishes a group logistics role, not the route or destination of a specific animal shipment.
claims.falsification_condition: A current company disclosure materially changes Wetralog's group role or live-animal transport activity.

claims.subject: Westfleisch SCE mbH
claims.claim: The Verband der Fleischwirtschaft lists Westfleisch SCE mbH among its members.
claims.boundary: Association membership does not prove agreement with, authorship of or direction of every VDF policy position.
claims.falsification_condition: A current VDF membership list no longer includes Westfleisch or corrects the entity.

claims.subject: Hubert Kelliger
claims.object: VDF board member linked to Westfleisch SCE
claims.claim: VDF lists Hubert Kelliger of Westfleisch SCE as a member of its board.
claims.boundary: A board role does not by itself prove that Westfleisch directed a specific VDF lobbying initiative or policy outcome.
claims.falsification_condition: A current VDF governance record changes the role or affiliation.

claims.subject: Verband der Fleischwirtschaft e.V.
claims.claim: The Bundestag Lobbyregister records a 2026 VDF lobbying initiative concerning the Tierhaltungskennzeichnungsgesetz.
claims.boundary: This is a VDF initiative; Westfleisch membership or a Westfleisch-linked board member does not make it a Westfleisch-authored position.
claims.falsification_condition: A corrected or superseding official Lobbyregister record changes the initiative or attribution.

claims.subject: Heinz Tummel GmbH & Co. KG
claims.claim: In a 2011 merger-control notice, the Bundeskartellamt stated that Tummel slaughtered quantities for Westfleisch under a contract-slaughter arrangement at that time.
claims.boundary: This is a historical competition-law context and does not establish a current commercial relationship or an animal-welfare finding.
claims.falsification_condition: A corrected official historical record shows the described contract-slaughter relationship was inaccurate.

claims.subject: Westfleisch Gute Haltung pig programme
claims.object: valid QS and Initiative Tierwohl certification at delivery
claims.claim: Westfleisch's 'Gute Haltung' criteria for pigs require a valid QS and Initiative Tierwohl certification at the time of delivery.
claims.boundary: A programme requirement does not show that all Westfleisch pigs participate, that requirements were met in every case, or that measured animal outcomes improved.
claims.falsification_condition: A current programme rule changes or removes the certification requirement.
